article.title: Google推Gemini Decisions API，可批次分類廣告素材
article.summary: Google的新端點可對同一份多模態素材回答多道預設問題，並回傳選項分數。
highlights: 每次請求最多處理1,000道獨立問題。
可經Google AI Studio免費試做原型。
article.why: 創意和媒體團隊可用一致問題標記素材，並把模糊結果送交人工審閱。
article.next_step: 選一批已標記的廣告素材，先比較自動分類與人工分類的差異。
article.detail: Google表示Gemini Decisions API會在一次處理內對同一份多模態輸入回答多道分類問題，並對選項給分。團隊可用固定的素材標籤試做分類，例如檢查品牌標誌是否出現或素材屬於哪個創意主題。分數是否適合做發布門檻，應先用已有人手標記的素材驗證，並為不確定個案保留人工覆核。
article.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API for batch creative classification
article.summary_en: Google's new endpoint can ask multiple predefined questions about the same multimodal input and return scores for the choices.
highlights_en: A request can contain up to 1,000 independent questions.
Teams can prototype at no cost in Google AI Studio.
article.why_en: Creative and media teams can use consistent labels and route ambiguous assets to reviewers.
article.next_step_en: Start with labeled ads and compare automated classification with human labels.
article.detail_en: Google says Gemini Decisions API evaluates multiple classification questions about one multimodal input in a single pass and scores the choices. Teams can try fixed creative tags such as logo presence or campaign theme. Validate scores against human-labeled assets before setting a publishing threshold and keep manual review for ambiguous cases.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
